The absence of deep white matter invasion also aligns with IDH-mutant gliomas. The T2-FLAIR mismatch score is 0.4, which is low and not indicative of the classic mismatch sign (which would suggest IDH-mutant astrocytoma). Given the mixed evidence, IDH-mutant is slightly favored but with low confidence.
